name: Microsoft 2.4GHz Transceiver v9.0 (mouse)
notes: 223-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Microsoft 2.4GHz Transceiver v9.0, from the udev-hid-bpf project's copy of the device's descriptor: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libevdev/udev-hid-bpf/-/blob/bbaad639d4b2efe2a909e8b7c594b91e87704ab8/doc/example-report-descriptor.rst#L122-122. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
